data.exact_reserve_text: The movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding, net of reinsurance recoveries is a favourable development of GBP 3.9m (2021: favourable development of GBP 6.1m); this is mainly comprised of releases of GBP 3.7m in respect of direct Third Party Liability business and releases of GBP 1.0m in respect of Aviation business, partially offset by strengthening of GBP 1.1m in Other direct.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Released the net reserve booked in 2020 against potential claims arising of GBP 2.0m (net release).

data.standardized_narrative: Gross claims outstanding opened the year at GBP 661.021m. Analysis of the gross claims development triangle shows a net adverse prior year development of GBP 32.627m (4.94% of opening reserves), driven by adverse movements across multiple earlier underwriting years (notably 2016-2019) partially offset by releases in certain older years (eg 2013) and targeted releases (including a GBP 2.0m net release of COVID-19 related reserves). The managing agent's narrative reports a small net favourable development on a net-of-reinsurance basis, reflecting significant reinsurer recoveries and programme effects; however the gross triangle indicates a material gross strengthening.
raw_causal_phrases: releases of GBP 3.7m in respect of direct Third Party Liability business
releases of GBP 1.0m in respect of Aviation business
partially offset by strengthening of GBP 1.1m in Other direct
released the net reserve booked in 2020 against potential claims arising of GBP 2.0m
uncertainties surrounding the current economic environment, loss exposure on opioids and other pharma losses
prior year releases across a number of casualty classes
data.data_quality_notes: The 'Movement in prior year's provision' textual note only provided a NET (after reinsurance) figure (GBP 3.9m favourable). Per instructions, the gross prior year development was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (notes, 'Gross of reinsurance' table). That triangle was used to compute changes by underwriting year (excluding 2021 and 2022) and summed to produce a gross PYD of +GBP 32.627m (adverse). Net and gross results therefore differ materially; users should note the triangle-based gross calculation and the fact the narrative movement quoted net-of-reinsurance amounts.
